test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Irene went to office __every single day by walk__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**every single day on foot.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is grammatically incorrect because "by walk" is not a proper English phrase.<
